name: hud_ui_options_panel_perspective_init_from_options
description: HudUiOptionsPanel_Perspective::InitFromOptions reads the current hardware-mode graphics flags and sets the perspective toggle checked state from the perspective bit.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the HUD options-panel source-file/table cluster. The current source restores behavior and table ownership; exact VC5SP3 byte comparison remains a later pass.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40ca20 calls zOpt::GetGraphicsFlagsForCurrentHwMode, masks zOpt_GraphicsFlags_Perspective, passes the result to HudUiCheckToggleWidget::SetChecked, and returns.

Native smoke zhud_options_panel_perspective_init_from_options_smoke installs software and hardware graphics flag option pointers, exercises both hardware-mode selectors, and verifies the checked state is set only when bit 0x08 is present.
